study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter, prospective study
exposure: Urine NGAL (neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin) at 12 and 24 h of life
Urine KIM-1 (kidney injury molecule 1) at 12 and 24 h of life
Urine IL-18 (interleukin-18) at 12 and 24 h of life
outcome: Brain MRI abnormalities (scored per NICHD criteria, specifically MRI Stage 2B or greater)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 57 neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) who underwent therapeutic hypothermia (TH).
finding: Elevated urine IL-18 at 24 hours of life was significantly associated with more severe brain MRI abnormalities (MRI Stage 2B or greater) in neonates with HIE.
